matchup.plan_md:
**ESPN sync:** Mo Bamba dropped, Kel'el Ware added (19 Nov).

**Both plans scored by `matchup.py`.** Each day was run on that day's roster with `--swap ... --from --end`. The table shows our lineup by day; 19 Nov is the same in both (84).

| Day | User's plan | Earlier plan |
|---|---:|---:|
| 20 Nov | 394 (Murphy, Queen) | 401 (Murphy, Grimes) |
| 21 Nov | 162 (Murphy, Queen) | 166 (Murphy, Queta) |
| 22 Nov | 353 (Murphy, Buzelis, Mara) | 354 (Buzelis, Queta) |
| 19–22 Nov | **993** | 1,005 |

**What it means:**
- They score 864 over the same days, so the user's plan projects about **1,814 to 1,641**.
- It uses all 7 adds.
- It keeps Murphy past this week, and it doesn't depend on Reaves.

**Drop Bey, not Missi, on 22 Nov.**
- Both give 353 that day, since neither plays.
- Bey starts only while Murphy is out ([CBS/RotoWire, 15 Nov](https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/pelicans-trey-murphy-wont-play-monday/)).

**Murphy:** still out; no timetable reported; *ESPN est.* 20 Nov.
- NO's report is due by about 10:00 AM Fri 20 Melbourne.
- If he sits 20–21 Nov, holding him costs about 60 against a streamer. The margin absorbs that.

**The moves** (Melbourne times):
1. **20 Nov:** drop Ware after his 19 Nov game. Add **Trey Murphy III** before NO @OKC (12:00 PM Sat 21).
2. **20 Nov:** drop Gobert after his 19 Nov game. Add **Derik Queen** before the same game.
3. **22 Nov:** drop Queen after NO @SA (tip-off 12:00 PM Sun 22). Add **Matas Buzelis** before CHI vs DEN (11:00 AM Mon 23).
4. **22 Nov:** drop Bey after NO @SA. Add **Aday Mara** before OKC @MIA (10:00 AM Mon 23).
